status: pre-registered before any GPU recomputation of the restored update-200 model
when: after load_checkpoint200 and before the first training step; a failure stops the run with CONTINUATION_GATE RESTORE_CHECK, no retry

gpu_recomputed_counts_must_equal_exactly.derivation: each retention integer is the unique integer consistent with the 4-decimal value recorded by the 200-update run (checked by a test)

why_no_tolerance: The recomputation is a teacher-forced argmax over 1920+1920+... tokens. Evidence it is not brittle: on Nov 10 2026 a CPU recomputation of the restored real checkpoint (different hardware, different kernels) reproduced X64 257/669 and all four recorded evals exactly (logs/cpu_smoke_result.json restoration_check). The GPU run uses the same T4 class and torch build as the run that recorded them.
if_it_stops: The stop happens before any training step and the observed counts are written to result.json; this is a restoration/hardware question for AJ, not something to retry or relax automatically. Any tolerance would need a new pre-registration.
cpu_smoke: records the same comparisons without stopping (strict=false); the parameter hash stays fatal
